title: Run an Election
callout: The Logbook Elections — secure digital voting

shots.say: Run a department election digitally, securely, and faster than paper ballots. Set it up on a tablet or computer.
shots.caption: Department elections, digitally

shots.say: Tap Create Election. Name it, set when voting opens and closes, and add the offices being contested.
shots.caption: Name, voting window, offices

shots.say: Choose Majority Required and turn on automatic runoffs. If nobody wins outright, a runoff is drafted for you.
shots.caption: Majority required, automatic runoffs on

shots.say: Then add candidates to each office, each with a statement.
shots.caption: Add candidates and statements

shots.say: Open the election, then send the ballot emails. Each eligible member gets their own ballot link.
shots.caption: Open Election → Send Ballot Emails

shots.say: Members vote from any device, from that link or by signing in.
shots.caption: Vote from any device

shots.say: When voting closes, the results are counted automatically, and closing the election releases them.
shots.caption: Counted automatically

shots.say: Secret ballots by default. No more counting paper until midnight.
shots.caption: Secret ballots by default
